name: abyss-descent
description: Isometric browser ARPG. The same static files ship on GitHub Pages and inside the Capacitor Android/iOS WebView.

scripts.test: node scripts/copy-www.js && node scripts/check-www.js && node scripts/check-routing.js && node scripts/check-survivor.js && node scripts/check-survivor-sim.js && node scripts/check-names.js && node scripts/check-rpg.js
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run copy:www && cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run copy:www && cap sync ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
